title: MiniCPM-V 4.7: a Vision Model That Runs on Your Phone
status: Owner selected this topic on 2026-10-16 (Top-10 pick). Default flow: render + frame-level QA, then Buffer scheduled send on YouTube/Instagram/Facebook. Approved Option-3 Chatterbox flow voice; no on-screen credit captions.
credits_on_screen: Own spec and device cards created for this video. Source links in post/description only. No on-screen credits.
verify_before_render: HF card+API 2026-10-16: 35B total/3B active vision MoE, Apache-2.0, 9,278 downloads. Phone speed (13+ tok/s, ~3 GB, iPhone 17 Pro Max) is OpenBMB's vendor figure, attributed; we did not run it.
Full weights are a large download; GGUF and other quantized builds exist. iOS/Android/HarmonyOS support is the vendor's statement.
Visuals are our own cards; no third-party clips. No on-screen credit captions.

scenes.heading: PHONE-BRAIN *VISION*
scenes.say: A model that sees images and video, small enough at heart to run on a phone.

scenes.heading: MEET *MINICPM-V 4.7*
scenes.say: This is {MiniCPM-V 4.7|Mini C P M V four point seven} from OpenBMB, a vision model built for devices.

scenes.heading: ON A *PHONE*
scenes.label: OpenBMB's test · iPhone 17 Pro Max · ~3 GB
scenes.say: OpenBMB reports over thirteen tokens a second on an iPhone, using about three gigabytes of memory.

scenes.heading: IT *SEES*
scenes.say: It reads single images, compares sets of them, and understands video too.

scenes.heading: RUN IT *YOUR WAY*
scenes.say: Grab the {GGUF|G G U F} build, or run it through Ollama, vLLM or SGLang.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *DOWNLOAD*
scenes.say: The catches: the phone speed is the vendor's own test, and the full weights are still a big download. But it is Apache two, and it runs on iPhone, Android and HarmonyOS.
Want phone-sized vision AI? Comment VISION and I will pin the model card.

youtube.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7: a Vision Model That Runs on Your Phone
youtube.description:
OpenBMB's MiniCPM-V 4.7 is a 35B vision-language MoE with only 3B active parameters. OpenBMB reports 13+ tok/s at about 3 GB of memory on an iPhone 17 Pro Max (vendor test; we did not run it). Apache-2.0, with GGUF, Ollama, vLLM and SGLang support.
Source: https://huggingface.co/openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B
